We also have Apple’s most affordable 15-inch M5 MacBook Air sitting at Amazon all-time low pricing ($200 off) and an extra $5 to $10 off already discounted Apple accessories – USB-C cables, Thunderbolt 5, MagSafe 3, and more from $4. Just be sure to scope out these rare deals on unlocked iPhone 17 Pro Max at up to $249 off today. Head below for a closer look.

Apple Watch Series 11 back to all-time lows: $100 off base models, $130 off GPS + Cell (All colors)

We are started to catch the return of all-time low pricing on Apple Watch Series 11 over this past weekend, but now all colors on the most popular models are back to the best prices to date. You’ll find the 42mm models from $299 with the same $100 price drop on the base 46mm, and now all colors of the GPS + Cell model are $130 off as well.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 from $299 (Reg. $399) – All colors
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell from $399 (Reg. $499) – All colors
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 from $329 (Reg. $429) – All colors
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell from $399 (Reg. $529) – All colors

As you can see above, Amazon is now delivering the all-time low pricing all four models of the base aluminum case variants and now you’ll find these prices on all four colors of each as well – Jet Black, Silver, Space Gray, and Rose Gold.

You’re looking at a solid $100 off for the GPS-only variants, but we are once again tracking that particularly notable deal on the 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell models at $130 off the list price – it is now sitting at the same price as the comparable and typically less expensive 42mm.

Just as a refresher from yesterday, here are the ongoing deals on the higher-end Titanium case models at up to $160 off:

Apple’s most affordable 15-inch M5 MacBook Air sitting at Amazon all-time low pricing ($200 off)

There were plenty of $150 price drops live oover the last few days on the M5 MacBook Air lineup, but Amazon is still offering this Midnight 15-inch configuration at $200 off the list to match the lowest price we have tracked.

We got a good run of $200 price drops across the 2026 Air lineup over the last couple weeks, but prices have jumped back up on just about all of them at this point save for this 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and the 512GB storage capacity at $1,099 shipped.

You’re looking at Apple’s entry and most affordable 15-inch Midnight treatment sitting down at the lowest price we have tracked to date. And considering just about everything else has jumped back up in price at this point, chances are this same $200 price drop is going to be where everything lands during Prime Day later this month – Amazon typically brings prices back up right before major sales and then back down to the previous lows, especially when it comes to current-generation MacBook models.

All M5 MacBook Air models are up at full price via Best Buy right now after going $150 off during its recent Apple Shopping Event – we recommend waiting until the model you’re after is $200 off, or close to it, before pulling the trigger considering how close to Prime Day we are.

We did catch an insane $549 price drop at Amazon on a single Sky Blue config yesterday afternoon, but it only lasted for about 10 minutes or so and very few folks are able to score one – it was more than likely just a price mistake on Amazon’s part.

Extra $5 to $10 off already discounted Apple accessories: USB-C cables, Thunderbolt 5, MagSafe 3, more from $4

Woot has now refreshed its official Apple accessory sale, and this time it is offering an extra $5 off the already reduced prices using code APPLEFIVE at checkout. New customers will receive an extra $10 off using the same code. We are looking at already discounted Apple USB-C cables and MagSafe 3 charging cables as well Thunderbolt 5 leads, Apple Watch chargers, and more. All of the eligible items are waiting on this landing page and we will take a closer look below.

One notable deal in the sale has Apple’s official 1-meter Thunderbolt 5 (USB‑C) Pro Cable marked down to $46.99 with free shipping for Prime members (a $6 delivery fee will apply otherwise). However, using code APPLEFIVE your total will drop down to $41.99, or as low as $36.99 if you’re a new Woot customer. Regularly $69, this is at least 40% off and the best price we can find.

This cable is currently up at the full $69 on Amazon where it is basically never on sale.

Apple’s 2026 mid-range 512GB M4 iPad Air drops back to Amazon low at $100 off today

We have been tracking the deal pricing on Apple’s latest 2026 M4 iPad Air lineup quite closely over the last few months, and today we are getting another shot at the mid-range 512GB 13-inch model at $100 off the list price.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s 13-inch M4 iPad Air with the 512GB storage capacity down at $999 shipped in blue.

Regularly $1,099, you’re looking at a solid $100 in savings here and the lowest price we can find in brand new condition. Today’s deal matches the lowest price we have tracked on this particular configuration since release in March 2026.

As of the time of writing, only the blue color is back at the Amazon low, but we will keep a close eye on the others. It is also worth pointing out that today’s deal is matching the lowest price we have tracked on the 512GB 13-incher in any color at Amazon.
